CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a jib reveal rising over a foreground object on a 35mm reportage, framing with deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control; grade as a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.
